name: George Touliatos
bio: George Touliatos (December 9, 1929 – December 8, 2017) was an American actor. He founded the Front St. Theatre in Memphis, Tennessee in 1958, and the actors who appeared there included George Hearn, Macon McCalman, Carrie Nye, Barbara Cason, Dixie Carter, Rita Gam and Dana Ivey. A pioneer in the regional theatre movement, Front St. Theatre produced a wide variety of dramas, comedies and musicals. On the screen, he is known for his roles in Prom Night (1980), The Sisterhood of the Traceling Pants (2005), and This Means War (2012).
